profile.headline: Software Engineer | Support Specialist
profile.summary:
As a software developer with a background in customer service and management, I am driven to leverage technology to create products that improve the lives of others.

My experience working in a health center instilled in me the fundamental importance of prioritizing patient needs, a principle that I have carried forward into the tech world. Working in management roles honed my teamwork, communication, and problem-solving skills, which I have found to be highly applicable in software development. Collaborating with others is crucial in coding, and my experience in customer service has instilled in me a natural desire to help others and contribute to a positive team environment. Ultimately, I aspire to work for a company that values collaboration and takes pride in crafting products that have a positive impact on the world.

In my free time, I enjoy exploring the outdoors, especially through trail running. I am also an avid reader and moviegoer, and am always up to chat about dogs! Feel free to contact me if you'd like to connect - I'd love to hear from you.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented a system to automatically detach coupons from subscriptions once usage limits were reached, replacing a manual process and saving valuable engineering time.
• Developed functionality to support prepaid annual subscriptions, expanding beyond monthly plans and
enabling discounted offerings to help reduce customer churn.
• Proactively resolved recurring support issues by identifying and addressing root causes, reducing ticket volume and freeing up team capacity for feature work.
• Enabled automated fund transfers to partners using the Stripe API integration.
• Contributed to a high-impact product redesign by developing React/TypeScript components within a Rails application, replacing server-rendered ERB with a React frontend to improve branding visibility, educate users, and boost conversion rates in the checkout flow.
positions.insights: Skills: Ruby on Rails · Hotwire: Turbo + Stimulus · CircleCI · RSpec · Tailwind CSS · Heroku · React.js · TypeScript

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Built and integrated multiple REST APIs to replace costly third-party tooling, improving reliability and
reducing expenses.
• Developed background workers with Sidekiq to automate notifications and streamline scheduling workflows.
• Provided backend engineering support for production issues tracked through Jira, ensuring timely resolution and minimal impact on users.
• Established seamless integration with Sertifi, enhancing Blueboard’s capability to cover hotel incidentals.
• Enhanced client experience by enabling further customization in the scheduling of reminder emails.
Worked closely with product and design teams to develop a new HR integration system (Merge).
• Authored technical documentation and integration diagrams, enabling faster onboarding for engineers and partners.
positions.insights: Skills: Ruby on Rails · Software Development · Back-End Web Development · GitHub · Git · Datadog · Test Driven Development · Docker · Debugging · CircleCI
